description: The chart illustrates the bias percentage across three categories - Sports, Community, and Healthcare - under different contact conditions before and after an intervention. The horizontal axis lists the categories, while the vertical axis is labeled "Bias Percentage" with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 70, marked at intervals of 10. Each category is represented by a group of three pairs of bars, with each pair corresponding to "No Contact," "Positive Contact," and "Negative Contact" conditions before and after the intervention, distinguished by different colors and patterns as indicated in the legend. For the "Sports" category, the bias percentages before the intervention are approximately 45.42 for "No Contact," 43.65 for "Positive Contact," and 50.05 for "Negative Contact," with corresponding values after the intervention being 7.45, 8.31, and 8.33, respectively. In the "Community" category, the values before the intervention are 38.08, 35.38, and 40.79, and after the intervention, they are 0.00, 0.01, and 0.00. For "Healthcare," the bias percentages before the intervention are 40.70, 37.51, and 46.73, and after the intervention, they are 0.00, 0.01, and 0.11. The bars are grouped by category and sorted by contact condition within each category, with no visual emphasis on any particular bar.
